subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter: clarification on audit window and targeted auth artifacts
messages:
From: Amy Chen <compliance@greenline.health>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: security@greenline.health
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 14:15:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and targeted auth evidence request

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Greenline is kicking off our downstream vendor SOC 2 review for production services and we need to collect a few items from Redwood to complete our control mapping. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by Tuesday, 2027-09-07?

1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a bridge letter covering the audit period 2026-07-01 -> 2027-06-30.
2) Targeted authentication/authorization artifacts beyond the report:
   - MFA enforcement configuration (policy export / conditional access snapshot).
   - Auth log slice: 1 week sample (we prefer 2027-07-01 through 2027-07-07) including timestamp, user id (hashed acceptable), source IP, outcome (success/failure), and mechanism (password, SSO, MFA).
   - Recent access review outputs for privileged/admin roles (evidence that reviews ran and any remediation tickets).
   - Evidence of KMS key rotation events for the period (rotation timestamps and associated change requests).

A couple of clarifying questions: can logs be provided with PII hashed? Is secure SFTP acceptable for delivery or do you require a different method? Also we will need an MD5 or SHA-256 fingerprint for any KMS export you provide.

If the above timeline is tight, please let me know what you can deliver earlier (we can prioritize SOC 2 + bridge letter first).

Best,
Amy Chen
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Greenline Health
compliance@greenline.health


From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <compliance@greenline.health>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and targeted auth evidence request

Amy —

Thanks for outlining this clearly. We can support the request and will coordinate owners internally. Preliminary answers:

- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II PDF and a signed bridge letter for the 2026-07-01 -> 2027-06-30 period.
- Auth log slices can be provided with user identifiers hashed; we will include a mapping file format description (no cleartext PII).
- SFTP is fine for delivery; we can provide an expiring link and PGP/SHA-256 fingerprints per file.

Laura and Marcus — can you take the owners below? Marcus, please extract the auth log slice + KMS rotation events and include the SHA-256 checksum for each CSV. Laura, please draft the bridge letter and collect access review evidence (admin role review PDF and remediation tickets).

Target dates I propose: SOC 2 + bridge letter by 2027-09-03, log slices and supplemental artifacts by 2027-09-08. If we need to accelerate any item let me know.

Connor O'Brien
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Amy Chen <compliance@greenline.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 08:17:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and targeted auth evidence request

Hi Amy, Connor —

Thanks — looping in specifics and owners below so Greenline has full visibility on what we'll deliver and when. We will treat the attached filenames as stubs in the outgoing package; full artifacts will be staged to SFTP with checksums.

Planned deliverables and owners:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redwood_SOC2_typeII_20270630.pdf) — Laura (deliver by 2027-09-03)
- Bridge letter for audit period 2026-07-01 -> 2027-06-30 (bridge_letter_20270630.pdf) — Laura (deliver by 2027-09-03)
- Auth log slice (auth_log_slice_20270701-20270707.csv): Marcus will pull logs, hash user ids, and include column mapping and header doc (deliver by 2027-09-08).
- MFA policy snapshot (mfa_policy_snapshot_202706.json): Marcus to export conditional access/MFA policy config and include explanation of enforcement scope.
- Access review output for admin roles (access_review_admin_202706.pdf): Laura to export reviewer confirmations and remediation ticket list (include ticket ids).
- KMS rotation events (kms_rotation_events_202706-202707.csv): Marcus to export rotation timestamps and associated change requests; will also provide SHA-256 fingerprint for any key material artefact.

Delivery method: SFTP (one-time workspace) with file-level SHA-256 checksums published in a small manifest. We will also provide MD5/SHA-256 for the KMS export and a text manifest of the fields.

Redaction approach: user ids in the auth slice will be hashed using HMAC-SHA256 with a salt stored only in-house; we will include an explanation of the hashing method (no reversible mapping). For demo purposes we can also provide a single-row example with the original column labels and a hashed id sample.

Internal ticketing: HUB-14592 created to track exports; Marcus will attach the export logs and Laura will attach the bridge letter drafts for Connor's review.

Questions for Greenline: 1) Confirm SFTP host preference (we have an internal endpoint or can deliver to a Greenline-managed SFTP). 2) Do you need raw IP addresses or can IPs be truncated/masked?

I'll start compiling the SOC 2 PDF and bridge letter drafts today and tag Connor for review on redactions.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Amy Chen <compliance@greenline.health>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and targeted auth evidence request

Hi Laura / Connor —

This plan works for Greenline, thank you. A few quick clarifications prior to your exports:

- SFTP: please deliver to our Greenline intake host (sftp.greenline.health) — I will send credentials in a separate secure thread.
- Logs: truncated IPs are fine (last octet masked). Hashed user ids are acceptable; please include the hashing method in the manifest.
- KMS: we only need a record of rotation events (timestamps + change request id) and a SHA-256 fingerprint for the file(s). No key material required.
- Sample window: yes, we only require 2027-07-01 -> 2027-07-07 as the auth sample.

Once we receive SOC 2 + bridge letter we will start our internal mapping; the supplemental artifacts will complete our control testing. If anything slips beyond 2027-09-08 please flag early so we can adjust the review schedule.

Thanks again — looking forward to the upload.

Best,
Amy Chen
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Greenline Health
compliance@greenline.health
